title: A gap in the open spin-one chain with fixed same-sign boundary fields
exact_target: For spin-one $H_L=sum_{j=-L}^{L-1}$ $S_j\cdot S_{j+1}-(3/5)(S_{-L}^z+S_L^z)$, is the difference between its two lowest eigenvalues, counted with multiplicity, greater than log(10)/392 for every integer $L\geq 960$?
